subject: Private plan commercial + onboarding terms for Bluecrest Analytics
messages:
From: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@bluecrest.ai>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@bluecrest.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Inquiry: Azure private plan commercial terms and onboarding timeline

Hi Rachel —

We're close to finalizing our cloud procurement window and want to include Redwood on an Azure private plan. Procurement asked for a single-sheet summary of the commercial terms (pricing band, seat/throughput entitlements, invoicing cadence) and a rough onboarding timeline for integration (VNet peering, private endpoints, SOC2 evidence required).

Can you share a commercial term sheet and confirm whether you can accept a standard PO + Net30? Also, is there flexibility on an initial committed capacity / ramp schedule — we expect 50% usage in Q1 then ramp.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call next week if needed.

Ryan Cole
Head of Platform Integrations
Bluecrest Analytics

Attachment: none
From: rachel.kim@redwood.ai <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Ryan Cole <ryan.cole@bluecrest.ai>
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@bluecrest.ai>, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: Azure private plan commercial terms and onboarding timeline

Ryan —

Thanks for the note. I've attached our current SOW + commercial exhibit (Redwood_SOW_Bluecrest_v3.docx) that outlines private-plan entitlements and billing options. High level answers below:

- Billing: We can accept a PO with Net30; standard invoice routing is to finance@bluecrest.ai.
- Committed capacity: We can structure a 3-month ramp (25% / 50% / 100% of committed baseline) and have a burst buffer for Q1.
- Onboarding: Typical timeline is 3 weeks for VNet setup + testing, additional 1–2 weeks for SOC2 evidence exchange and attestation.
- Co-sell: We can commit to a co-sell GTM motion; terms and revenue split are negotiable (we typically propose a 70/30 split for partner-originated deals).

I've looped in Stephanie to confirm commercial flexibility and Naomi for billing/invoicing flow. Can we lock a call on Monday 12/14 at 10am PT?

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_SOW_Bluecrest_v3.docx (SOW + commercial exhibit)
From: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Bluecrest commercial levers + approval path

Team —

Quick notes after reviewing Rachel's SOW and the ask from Bluecrest:

- Discounting: We can offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first-quarter committed spend (marketing/promotional credit), but margin-sensitive discounts beyond that need finance sign-off.
- Ramp schedule: Approve the 3-month ramp Rachel proposed; include a clause that overage beyond committed baseline will be billed at on-demand rate (we should call out specific per-token rates in the Pricing_Exhibit).
- Co-sell: Marissa, do we have capacity for a joint HEAT call with Azure seller execs? The customer specifically requested co-sell enablement.
- PO / Net30: Naomi confirms we can accept Net30. Need procurement contact + invoice routing to match Bluecrest's vendor portal.

Jonas — please scope any need for legal redlines on indemnity/data residency or DPA changes (they raise SOC2). If legal wants to limit indemnity exposure for a private-plan listing, flag it now.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 10:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private plan commercial + onboarding terms for Bluecrest Analytics

Rachel / Team —

Thanks for the documents and the call today — that was helpful. Attached is our procurement redline (Bluecrest_Redline_20261214.pdf) with the following high-level asks:

1) Payment: prefer Net45 for initial term; can move to Net30 after successful onboarding and production cutover.
2) Data residency: must commit to Azure region US-West-2 for all model serving and KV cache persistence (we need this in writing).
3) Liability: procurement pushed back on Redwood's broad indemnity; they propose a capped liability equal to the annual committed spend.
4) Marketplace entitlements: Bluecrest wants the private plan listing to include an admin entitlement for their platform team to manage entitlements in the Azure portal (we need a short-runbook).

We'll also return a signed PO once we have agreement on these three points.

Regards,
Ryan Cole
Head of Platform Integrations
Bluecrest Analytics

Attachments: Bluecrest_Redline_20261214.pdf
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Bluecrest commercial levers + approval path

All —

Legal responses to the redline and next steps below (summarized for commercial):

- Net45 request: we will accept Net45 for the first invoice only; after production cutover and verification (30 days), billing cycles move to Net30. Please include an explicit clause.
- Data residency: we will commit to US-West-2 model serving and KV persistence for the private plan; we will add a service-level attestation in the SOW.
- Liability cap: propose capped liability at 200% of annual committed spend rather than 100% — gives Redwood protection while being palatable to procurement. If customer pushes back, we can offer 100% capped liability if they accept a higher onboarding credit or slightly higher unit price.
- Admin entitlement in Marketplace: engineering will provide a one-page runbook; Rachel, please ask the customer who will be the admin contact (email) so we can provision.

Action items:
- Rachel: share proposed updated SOW + Pricing_Exhibit with the changes above by EOD today.
- Stephanie/Naomi: confirm updated invoice routing and PO acceptance language.
- Rachel: forward runbook stub and admin provisioning instructions once customer confirms admin contact.

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
